intro: Lashana Lynch portrays Brianna Young, the Cassiopeia pilot. Official character names, roles and where to verify performance credits.

blocks.text: The official game website identifies Lashana Lynch as Brianna Young. Young is the Cassiopeia’s pilot and Bill Young’s daughter. The previously published name Brooke Osmond was incorrect.

The official roster identifies Laura Eisele as Senior Mission Officer, Samantha Cooper as Medical Specialist, Josef Cernan as Technical Engineer and Nolan Stafford as Commander. A character’s job is distinct from an actor’s performance credit.

Use the game’s credits to distinguish voice performance, likeness and motion capture. A familiar face alone does not prove who provided the voice. This page does not guess credits that are absent from the official game presentation.
